incidents.location: Edmonds Way, Edmonds, WA
incidents.desc: Rideshare driver Abdikadir Gedi Shariif, 31, shot 11 times in his car by Alex Waggoner after nearly striking Waggoner as a pedestrian. Shariif died at Harborview Medical Center. Waggoner arrested Jan 10, 2024. Found guilty July 2025, sentenced to ~20 years (235 months) on Sep 17, 2025.

incidents.location: S Martin Luther King Jr Way & S Cloverdale St, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Uber driver Abdirizak Aden shot at by occupants of a car that pulled up alongside at a red light at 12:40 AM. Aden ducked and was NOT injured — bullets struck the engine and body of his vehicle, totaling the car. Suspects fled.

incidents.location: Tukwila, WA
incidents.desc: Rideshare driver stabbed by a female passenger in Tukwila. Incident occurred one week before the April 2024 Atlantic City Boat Ramp attack, cited by Fox 13 as part of a growing pattern of violence against app-based drivers.

incidents.location: Atlantic City Boat Ramp, 8800 Seward Park Ave S, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Uber driver (37-year-old woman) picked up group at Atlantic City Boat Ramp. After she refused to drive without a car seat for a child, passengers assaulted her — punched in head, knocked to ground, struck with driftwood. Car window smashed, belongings stolen. Suspects fled the scene.

incidents.location: Unincorporated Thurston County, WA
incidents.desc: Driver Ahmed Hassan Ali, 58, charged with 2nd-degree rape and 1st-degree kidnapping after marking ride complete and assaulting intoxicated passenger. Incident led to Seattle-area driver strike on June 26, 2024.

incidents.location: 1st Ave S & Airport Way S, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Armed robbery of rideshare driver; suspect demanded vehicle at gunpoint. Driver escaped on foot. Vehicle recovered 2 hours later near Georgetown.

incidents.location: Broadway & E Pike St, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Delivery driver robbed at knifepoint while making late-night delivery. Phone and cash stolen. Suspect fled northbound on Broadway.

incidents.location: 2nd Ave & Bell St, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Driver physically assaulted by passenger who refused to pay surge pricing. Passenger struck driver multiple times before fleeing vehicle.

incidents.location: Westlake Ave N & Thomas St, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Amazon Flex driver carjacked at gunpoint while loading packages. Two suspects, one armed. Vehicle recovered in Beacon Hill the next day.

incidents.location: Rainier Ave S & S Orcas St, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Driver robbed by two passengers who exited vehicle and reached back in to grab phone and bag while arguing. Driver required stitches for cut on hand.

incidents.location: University Way NE & NE 45th St, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Delivery driver assaulted by group of 3 males after completing a delivery. Phone smashed, minor injuries. Suspects fled toward Husky Stadium.

incidents.location: Bellevue, WA (during Uber ride)
incidents.desc: Uber driver Martin Njoki, 43, charged with indecent liberties and unlawful imprisonment with sexual motivation after sexually assaulting a 16-year-old passenger during a ride drop-off. Arrested April 10, 2025. Held on $150,000 bail, later reduced to $30,000. Pleaded not guilty April 25, 2025. Case ongoing.

incidents.location: Beacon Ave S & S McClellan St, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Driver robbed by passenger posing as fare. Passenger pulled weapon at destination and demanded cash and phone before fleeing on foot.

incidents.location: Airport Way S & S Lucile St, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Driver shot in arm during robbery attempt near industrial area. Hospitalized in stable condition. Suspect vehicle described as dark-colored SUV.

incidents.location: 16th Ave SW & SW Roxbury St, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Driver robbed of entire delivery load. Two suspects blocked vehicle, forced driver out, and drove off with van containing packages.

incidents.location: IHOP parking lot, near Paine Field, Everett, WA
incidents.desc: Lyft/Uber driver Yuriy Vakulchik attacked from behind in IHOP parking lot while preparing to pick up passengers at Paine Field. Suspect sliced victim multiple times in neck and head, then fled in victim's SUV. Suspect arrested near Costco in Lynnwood. Vakulchik hospitalized, survived.

incidents.location: 1st Ave S & S Washington St, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Driver attacked by intoxicated group exiting nearby bar at 2 AM. Sustained facial injuries. Incident captured on dashcam footage submitted to SPD.

incidents.location: Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Violent encounter during Uber ride documented by KIRO 7. Physical altercation between parties during an active ride in Seattle.

incidents.location: 7000 block Lincoln Park Way SW, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Uber driver and passenger robbed at gunpoint at 2:17 AM by two masked suspects who used a Chevy Silverado to block the vehicle on Lincoln Park Way SW. Suspects demanded valuables from both driver and passenger. Same suspects had robbed another driver 7 minutes earlier at 35th Ave SW & SW Thistle St. Suspect truck recovered at 59th Ave SW & Alki Ave SW. Three suspects fled in separate vehicles.

incidents.location: Roosevelt Way NE & NE Northgate Way, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Driver accosted near Northgate Transit Center while completing delivery. Bag and food items stolen. Suspect fled via light rail platform.

incidents.location: Rainier Ave S & S Henderson St, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Driver assaulted during passenger dispute over route. Passenger grabbed steering wheel, causing near-collision, then struck driver when stopped.

incidents.location: Vancouver, WA
incidents.desc: Rideshare driver's car rammed four times by a pursuing vehicle in a domestic violence attack. Rear of vehicle collapsed, back window shattered, car pushed near 20-foot embankment. Driver managed to drive to Vancouver police precinct. Hospitalized. Suspect's vehicle recovered.

incidents.location: 4th Ave S & S Lander St, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Armed robbery near SODO. Suspect approached driver on delivery stop, demanded packages at gunpoint. Driver complied and was unharmed. Three packages stolen.

incidents.location: Terry Ave & E Madison St, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Driver ambushed by two suspects while delivering food near Harborview. Phone, cash and delivery bag stolen. Driver sustained minor injuries.

incidents.location: Rainier Ave S & S Ferdinand St, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Driver forced from vehicle at gunpoint on Valentine's Day night. Suspects took vehicle with phone inside. Vehicle recovered 48 hours later in SeaTac.

incidents.location: 11th Ave & E Terrace St, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Drunk 16-year-old shot up a pizza parlor, then attempted to carjack an Uber driver at gunpoint on 11th Ave near E Terrace St. Driver escaped uninjured. Teen arrested by SPD.

incidents.location: Denny Way & 7th Ave, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Driver harassed and physically assaulted by unhoused individual while stopped at delivery location. Required ER visit for broken wrist.

incidents.location: Delridge Way SW & SW Genesee St, Seattle, WA
incidents.desc: Driver robbed of delivery packages by group of 3 suspects near Delridge Community Center. Suspects arrived in stolen vehicle.

incidents.location: King County Courthouse / orig. 1st Ave S near Walker St, Seattle
incidents.desc: Ne'iana Allen-Bailey sentenced to 20 years for the August 2023 murder of Uber/Lyft driver Amare Geda, 52, at 1st Ave S near Walker St in SODO. Allen-Bailey shot Geda during an altercation after a ride. King County Prosecutors secured conviction.
incidents.source: Fox 13 / KOMO / KIRO 7 / King Co. Prosecutors

incidents.location: Uber HQ / 22 states including WA
incidents.desc: NYT investigation (published Feb 19–20, 2026) reveals Uber approved drivers convicted of child abuse, stalking, and assault if convictions were 7+ years old in 22 states. From 2017–2022, Uber received a sexual assault or misconduct report every 8 minutes on average. Uber announced policy changes to ban violent felons regardless of conviction age.

incidents.location: Ninth Circuit Court / Seattle OLS
incidents.desc: Ninth Circuit upholds Seattle's App-Based Worker Deactivation Rights Ordinance (case 25-231) against challenge by Uber and Instacart. Law requires large delivery app companies to set clear deactivation policies, provide notice before deactivations, and give workers access to records. Major victory for Seattle Office of Labor Standards. OLS press release March 6, 2026.
incidents.source: City of Seattle OLS / Ninth Circuit
